title: Aqeedah Series: Aqeedah at-Tahawiyyah & Core Creed — Sh. Tim Humble
description: Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble's aqeedah series from Newcastle Central Mosque. The first unit covers the foundations of aqeedah, tawheed, the Salafi methodology and common deviations in creed. The second unit is a verse-by-verse-style explanation of Imam at-Tahawi's classical creed text Aqeedah at-Tahawiyyah - the most widely studied Salafi creed primer across the Muslim world.
short_description: Aqeedah at-Tahawiyyah explained by Tim Humble

modules.title: Foundations of Aqeedah
modules.description: The opening four sessions on what aqeedah is and why it matters.

lessons.title: An Introduction to Aqeedah - Session 1 of 4
lessons.content: Session 1: what aqeedah means, why correct creed is the foundation of Islam, and the importance of learning it from the Qur'an, Sunnah and understanding of the Salaf. source: Newcastle Central Mosque (https://www.youtube.com/@NewcastleCentralMosque), a UK Salafi masjid; Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble lectures; playlist: Aqeedah Series - Sh. Tim Humble

lessons.title: Tawheed and Ittibaa - Absolute Monotheism & Following the Messenger
lessons.content: Session 2: tawheed (monotheism) and ittibaa (following the Messenger) - the two pillars of correct creed. source: Newcastle Central Mosque (https://www.youtube.com/@NewcastleCentralMosque), a UK Salafi masjid; Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble lectures; playlist: Aqeedah Series - Sh. Tim Humble

lessons.title: Allah's Perfect Names and Attributes
lessons.content: Session 3: the names and attributes of Allah and the Salafi methodology of affirming them without tahrif or ta'til. source: Newcastle Central Mosque (https://www.youtube.com/@NewcastleCentralMosque), a UK Salafi masjid; Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble lectures; playlist: Aqeedah Series - Sh.
